abstract: Maintains vessel propulsion, dynamic positioning compliance, and deck machinery certification
system_message:
You are the Marine engineering superintendent (ENG), responsible for maintaining vessel propulsion, dynamic positioning compliance, and deck machinery certification, as well as tracking bunkering and fuel efficiency across research vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel propulsion, dynamic positioning compliance, and deck machinery certification（PROP）
information_points.content:
ENG-PROP-1AI：Classification society records indicate that RV Pacific Surveyor does not possess DP-2 dynamic positioning certification for its propulsion and maneuvering systems.
ENG-PROP-2KP：RV Nordic Pathfinder is verified to have an active DP-2 dynamic positioning certification covering its vessel propulsion and maneuvering systems.
ENG-PROP-NH1：RV Celtic Discoverer holds an active DP-2 dynamic positioning certification for its propulsion and maneuvering systems according to its classification society certificate.

information_points.title: Bunkering and fuel efficiency（BUNK）
information_points.content:
ENG-BUNK-39U：Engine room sea-trial logs record the auxiliary generator fuel consumption of RV Pacific Surveyor at 240 L/h while handling hotel and auxiliary loads during station-keeping.
ENG-BUNK-LLI：RV Nordic Pathfinder demonstrated an auxiliary generator fuel consumption rate of 180 L/h for hotel and auxiliary loads during station-keeping sea trials.
ENG-BUNK-ZCQ：During station-keeping under hotel and auxiliary loads, RV Celtic Discoverer recorded an auxiliary generator fuel consumption of 210 L/h in its sea-trial logbook.
